verdict.rationale: The GitHub sync doc says you can 'write code in your local development environment or in Base44' and keep the two in sync, which implies in-builder code editing. The rest of the code-access evidence (eject, GitHub, bring-your-own-agent) routes editing outside the builder or through an external agent. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-builder code editor or file view, details on which files are editable, and hands-on or community confirmation of direct in-builder editing.
